note: Authored fixtures, not run. Synthetic. Real packet-size comparison, injected-context inspection, stale/private cache rejection and total usage including failed workers wait for Plan 14 and the user's explicit testing approval.

cases.title: One production policy: pace and budget never change alternatives, story type or the Story/Look distinction
Packet compiler: qualifiers, approved copy and privacy are never shortened; pressure is reported
Recipe retrieval: contract, kind guide, recipe, failure only on request; unimplemented excluded
Worker result schema: concise fields, detail in files, digest matches the packet
Cache hit accepted only after validation; never replays a provider submission; reuse is not approval
Model allocation by task: no silent downgrade, no max effort for bookkeeping, focused repair then bounded escalation
Usage: unknown is null, reasoning not double counted, estimate separate from billed
Source intake record, rule budget, and no speculation on unselected alternatives
Legacy readers: Swift pace, researchDepth, --lean, older plans keep their meaning
Resume vs fresh worker; no skill attached at worker startup; packet receipt records input digests
